summary: Tested the re-rigged FAIRINO FR3-WMS hero cobot animation on the live preview URL. Hero layout and content are unchanged (name, kicker, FEATURED tag, canvas, FEATURED PROJECT chip, Cobot title). The data-testid='hero-centerpiece' element exposes __scene, __setTime, __isRunning hooks; nodes J1..J6 are all present. Live sampling over ~14s shows J1(y), J2(x), J3(x), J5(y) ramp up together with cosine easing and return to ~0 — the 11s five-pose loop (Home->Reach->Weld Dip->Lift->Return) repeats cleanly. J4(z) and J6(x) stay exactly at 0 as specified. __setTime(t) deterministically seeks to distinct poses at t=0, 3.0, 4.65, 6.7, 10.9 (each returns distinct non-zero/zero joint vectors). Pause/resume via IntersectionObserver works: scrolling the hero offscreen freezes rotations and sets __isRunning=false; scrolling back resumes animation. prefers-reduced-motion emulation renders the static Home pose with joint rotations exactly zero and running=false. Canvas does not hijack mouse wheel — page scrolls normally. OrbitControls drag of ~120px does not open the project modal; a plain click on the hero canvas opens the Cobot Ultrasonic Welding modal. Screenshots at __setTime(0), __setTime(4.65), __setTime(6.7) show clean elbow and wand-root seams with no dislocation or dark gap. Skills (Design / Analysis & Manufacturing / Automation & Robotics), all four project cards (Cobot, FANUC, Eco, VEX), Timeline, and the linkedin.com/in/carlos-sibaja-enginnering link are all present. Zero console errors captured during the full flow.
critical_code_review_comments: HeroRobot.jsx (~265 lines) is well scoped. Consider extracting KEYFRAMES/poseAt into a small util for unit testing in future, not required now.
Three.js OrbitControls, scene, renderer are correctly disposed on unmount — no leaks observed across reload cycles.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Hero cobot rig v2 is correct: nodes J1..J6, axes [y,x,x,z,y,x]. Test hooks on [data-testid=hero-centerpiece]: __scene, __setTime(seconds)->bool, __isRunning(). Five-pose 11s loop with KEYFRAMES at (0,0.8,3.0,4.2,5.1,6.7,8.9,11.0). J4/J6 held at 0 by design. Reduced motion renders static home. Click on hero opens Cobot modal via parent Hero.jsx onClick=open; drag (>6px) is suppressed by onClickCapture + dragged flag in HeroRobot.jsx. Pause via IntersectionObserver + visibilitychange works.
